It is interesting to consider other encoders for LZ77. Many practical compressors utilize a type of phrase encoders that is strikingly different from ours: such encoders use entropy compression as a component. DEFLATE and LZMA are important examples of compression schemes using such techniques. This is a major open problem to formalize these schemes and to conduct a similar theoretical analysis of the efficiency of the popular greedy approach.
